Description
Queen Mary University of London is proud to offer a five-year Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) programme taught on the Mediterranean islands of Malta. The MBBS is taught by Barts and The London School of Medicine and Dentistry, a faculty of Queen Mary, a member of the Russell Group of leading research-led UK universities. Ranked 2nd in The Guardian University Guide 2020 and The Complete University Guide 2020, 3rd in the world for research citations in medicine by the QS World University Rankings 2019.
